title: 2432: Improve performance when selecting asset
body:
Fixes #2384 #2386 #2432 

Hi @IanMayo, I just made some changes to reduce rendering, it seems the performance has improved (it only takes 1~2 seconds when this table loads 250 rows)

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/219589492-360f1a60-bfd5-4e76-aea5-6ca28c2a37bf.mov

But I found that the material table itself has an performance issue when enable/disable the filter, it makes 3~5s to applied, I'm investigating it.

comments_data.body:
Brilliant!

It looks like it needs a bit more review - will do that later.

@lebaphi - you've lost some of my changes 🤣 

For the material tables, I have added a new tool button for `planning-messages`, and provided two-state icons for `planning-messages` and `planning-assets`.  The original bits are in red in `Files Changed`.

review_comments_data.body: hello @lebaphi -  your code has dropped the extra parameter for the next two calls - that will prevent some functionality from working.

issues.title: Performance Problem with `Select Assets`
issues.body:
We are experimenting with increasing the number of rows displayed in the `PlanningAssets` table:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/219419096-a7d25de2-377a-40cf-a57b-41db19c14298.png)

But, with 500 rows visible, it can take 5+ Seconds for a row to be marked as `Selected`.  See the video from phi here:
https://github.com/serge-web/serge/issues/2386#issuecomment-1432997117

I _think_ the delay is related to the icons on the map.  Could you investigate please, and see if you can find the bottleneck?
